summary: The team discussed and decided on the design and features of a new remote control. The device will have a flip design with a unique shape reflecting the company's image. It will feature an LCD display on top and rubberized buttons on the bottom. The body will be plastic with a rubberized cover, and the color scheme will be based on fruit and vegetables. The team decided against voice recognition. Battery options considered included rechargeable, solar, kinetic, and standard batteries, with a final decision on kinetic charging and watch-type batteries. The design aims to be stylish, innovative, and easy to use, with a focus on user experience.
